name: Maritupirdine
summary: Maritupirdine (developmental code name AVN-101), a close structural analogue of latrepirdine, is a selective 5-HT6 receptor antagonist which is under development by Avineuro Pharmaceuticals for the treatment of Alzheimer's disease and anxiety disorders. As of November 2013, it was in phase II clinical trials for these indications.

fact.en: It is a close relative of latrepirdine, an old Russian antihistamine sold as Dimebon that was tested for Alzheimer's disease but failed in large trials.
fact.zh: 它是 latrepirdine 的近親，後者是一種以 Dimebon 為名販售的老牌俄羅斯抗組織胺，曾被試驗用於阿茲海默症，但在大型試驗中失敗。
